verdict.rationale: Homebrew documents one package manager across macOS and Linux, and its docs claim it can also manage Windows systems. The more specific homepage wording says that means WSL, not native Windows. A Brewfile can carry the same declarative config across environments and lists WinGet packages as a supported entry type, but some entry types (casks, Mac App Store) are inherently macOS-oriented. missing for 10: evidence of native Windows support beyond WSL, documentation that one Brewfile works unchanged across all three OSes, independent hands-on corroboration of cross-platform use.
